answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a scarce external credential before it can transact, so minting a thousand sybils costs as much as drilling a thousand shale wells rather than nothing. Honest agents recover their stake plus fees; detected fakes forfeit it. Pair this with reputation that accrues only over time, like sediment, so a sudden tide of fresh identities cannot outvote agents who earned trust slowly, and tag each with a unique signing key — no two share the same violet.
